sunrock-guesthouse.address: 11 Park Street, 1619 Kempton Park, South Africa
sunrock-guesthouse.notes:
Complimentary airport shuttle from OR Tambo International Airport.

After collecting luggage, call or WhatsApp one of the following:
• Manager on duty: 00/+27 83 376 5190
• Driver Tony: 00/+27 60 336 2800
• Landline: 00/+27 11 394 3772

Pick-up point: Bus terminal just opposite the International Arrivals Hall, behind the Intercontinental Hotel. Wait in the outside section of the bus terminal.

Vehicles have a Sunrock Guesthouse sticker. Shuttle back to airport can be confirmed with reception on arrival.

Airport WIFI is free (no password needed).
